load_data_graph: load graph data from prefix and dataset into a RawGraph object with features and splits
load_adjacency_matrix: load a sparse adjacency matrix from npz or npy files in the dataset directory
validate_bin_files: validate binary adjacency files and return None if required files are missing
normalize_node_features: normalize node features using StandardScaler with train or all data mode
convert_raw_data_to_shadow: convert raw dataset files into shaDow format for graph engine consumption
